runtime: Actual HalcLandscape and LandscapeCache classes; fake DOM/map transport only. One retry test also uses actual readJSON over mocked fetch + real gzip decoding.

results.name: Every ineligible date/mode/modern/terrain/borders/zoom/view/destroyed context does zero network or source writes
Source readiness gates first visibility and settled features
Same context retains the rendered frame while a new viewport loads and renders
Closing/changing date during late shard data prevents all late source/style writes
An old viewport request cannot replace a newer settled frame
A network-rejected shard is evicted and explicit retry can load it
A semantically invalid cached shard is evicted for explicit retry
A semantically invalid cached index is evicted for explicit retry
Separate maps may share immutable requests while rendering readiness remains independent
A failure in one map/source does not poison another map with the same loader
A GPU/source error is recoverable by recreating the source on explicit retry
Semantic retry also evicts the actual readJSON parsed-response cache
Different loaders never share cached content
Coverage tests the actual rendered point and does not assume the archive bbox is filled
Turning terrain/borders/modern/mode/date off immediately hides and restores original layer order
Late reference insertion reconciles once, is idempotent, and remains ordered after exit
Repeated unchanged updates and idle produce no network or map style writes
Destroy removes listeners and late data/retry/idle cannot write to the map
Destroy after a rendered frame makes later retry and reconciliation strict no-ops
Worker branch sends a Blob URL while panel metadata retains exact ID/order/properties and waits for source readiness
Superseding two enqueued Blob frames preserves both URLs until final source readiness, then settles only the latest metadata
Leaving the eligible year cancels pending worker preparation and never allocates a stale Blob
An already queued Blob remains readable while source loads after year exit and is reclaimed on completion without showing stale geography
Worker availability failure falls back once to the existing data path; later views do not restart a broken worker
Ordinary worker data errors preserve the explicit-retry experience rather than silently retrying via the main thread
Destroy reclaims already-created Blob URLs, releases its worker lease once and ignores pending source events
A custom parent loader cannot be silently bypassed by the automatic Worker path
Guide uses metadata fields only and displays original dates, quality, bibliography, remarks and overlap order
